title: Renewal Window, Automatic Renewal and Early Cancellation Settlement of the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs
content:
Terms addressed to the building owner on the renewal and the early ending of a program under the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs.

**Clause 1. Renewal.** The renewal window opens the tier's renewal period before the term end, and where the tier renews automatically the program renews at the escalated price unless a non-renewal notice was received by the tier's notice deadline, counted back in calendar days from the term end date with the deadline day counting as timely.

**Clause 2. Early cancellation.** On early cancellation the tier's cancellation rate is applied to the unbilled remainder of the term and undelivered included sets are refunded at the tier's refund portion.

### Clause 1 read as conditions

| Tier renews automatically | Non-renewal notice received on or before the deadline | Result at term end |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | The program renews for a further term at the escalated price |
| Yes | Yes | The program does not renew automatically |
| No | Not read | The program does not renew automatically |

The escalated price is the program price increased by the tier's escalation percentage of that price. On a hypothetical program price of 5,000 USD and an escalation of 4.5 percent, the escalation is 225 USD and the renewed price is 5,225 USD.

The deadline is the day that falls the tier's notice period in calendar days before the term end date, and a notice received on the deadline day is timely. On hypothetical dates, a term ending on 2026-06-30 under a 30-day notice period has its deadline on 2026-05-31: a notice received on 2026-05-31 is timely, and a notice received on 2026-06-01 is late. The day a written notice was received in the office is the day read for this purpose.

The renewal window opens the tier's renewal period in calendar days before the term end; a program whose window has opened stands in pending renewal status until it is renewed, lapses or is suspended.

### Clause 2 read as an amount

The early cancellation fee is the unbilled remainder of the term multiplied by the tier's cancellation rate. The refund for filters is the tier's refund portion of the undelivered included sets. On hypothetical inputs, a program with an unbilled remainder of 3,000 USD at a cancellation rate of 25 percent carries a fee of 750 USD; the same remainder at a rate of 40 percent carries a fee of 1,200 USD; at a rate of 0 percent it carries no fee. Where 8 included sets are undelivered at a refund portion of 50 percent, 4 sets' worth is refunded; at 100 percent, all 8; at 0 percent, none.
